subsystem: UIKitCore.framework & SpringBoard - Status Bar Tap Scroll-To-Top Kinematics & Responder Selection

system_event_pipeline.description: Hardware touch digitized in status bar area (screen y < statusBarHeight, typically 54.0pt on iPhone 18,3 Dynamic Island).
SpringBoard processes status bar tap and transmits Mach IPC scroll-to-top event to key application process scene.
Application receives event and dispatches internal selector -[UIWindow _scrollToTopFromTouchAtScreenLocation:animate:].

parameters: screenLocation: CGPoint coordinates of status bar touch in screen coordinate space
animate: BOOL flag indicating animated transition (YES)
entry_point.return_type: BOOL (YES if a qualifying scroll view handled the gesture, NO otherwise)

candidate_scroll_view_selection_algorith.traversal_strategy: Recursive depth-first search of window view hierarchy, inspecting all registered or visible subviews.

qualification_criteria.rationale: Candidate must be a UIScrollView or a specialized subclass (e.g. UITableView, UICollectionView, UITextView).
Explicit opt-in property; default is YES for standard scroll views, NO for helper/internal views.
View must be attached to an active window and visually rendered.
View frame must intersect visible window display boundaries.
Content must be vertically scrollable; views with zero scrollable overflow cannot scroll to top.
Scroll view must not already be rested at minimum top offset.

exclusivity_rule.specification: If the view hierarchy search yields exactly 1 qualifying candidate, that scroll view is triggered. If the search yields 0 candidates OR >= 2 candidates with scrollsToTop == YES, NO SCROLL VIEW IS SCROLLED.
exclusivity_rule.failure_behavior: Silent no-op; returns NO from _scrollToTopFromTouchAtScreenLocation:animate: to prevent jarring multiple simultaneous scrolls.

permission_query.default_behavior: If delegate does not implement selector, default response is YES.
permission_query.action_on_no: If delegate returns NO, scroll-to-top sequence is aborted immediately without animation.

completion_notification.dispatch_condition: Dispatched upon animation completion when contentOffset.y reaches top target within resting tolerance (|y - y_target| < 0.5pt).
completion_notification.action_on_interruption: Suppressed if animation is interrupted by touch, cancellation, or programmatic override.

target_content_offset.horizontal_preservation: Current horizontal contentOffset.x is strictly preserved during vertical scroll-to-top.

timing_curve.refresh_rate_integration: Stepped per frame across 60Hz/80Hz/120Hz ProMotion displays via CADisplayLink targetTimestamp.

interruption_handling.touch_interruption: If user touches screen while scroll-to-top animation is in flight, UIKit immediately halts animation via _stopScrollingAndFillDisplayList:, invalidates display link, freezes offset at presentation coordinate, collapses touch slop to 0.0pt, and transitions to interactive dragging.
interruption_handling.multi_touch_cancellation: Multi-touch pinch zoom gestures (UIPinchGestureRecognizer) enforce mutual exclusivity: beginning or changing pinch immediately halts scroll-to-top animation flight, invalidates CADisplayLink, and updates zoomScale. High-frequency touch cancellation (touchesCancelled:withEvent:) immediately invalidates CADisplayLink and resets dragging state.
interruption_handling.suppress_completion: scrollViewDidScrollToTop: is NOT invoked if interrupted.

decompiled_routines.role: Status bar touch dispatcher executing candidate filtering and animation initiation.
Direct status bar tap entry point parameterized by screen X coordinate forwarding to 2D touch location dispatcher.
Registers scroll view with internal scroll-to-top registry when scrollsToTop == YES and view moves to window.
Unregisters scroll view when removed from window or scrollsToTop set to NO.
Setter mutating scrollsToTop bitfield and triggering registration/unregistration.
Getter returning target content offset for programmatic scroll animation.
Setter configuring target content offset for programmatic scroll animation.
Halts active scroll-to-top animation flight, invalidates CADisplayLink, freezes presentation offset, and sets isDragging = 1.
Halts active animation flight, invalidates CADisplayLink, and resets isDragging = 0.
